headline: EPS falls sharply q/q but is up sharply year-over-year
summary_short: DVx reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥1.67, down 73.2% q/q but up 255.3% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of ¥1.67 fell 73.2% sequentially from ¥6.22 but rose 255.3% year-over-year from ¥0.47. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
